# What the year-end summary leaves out

The repair count, volunteer attendance and clinic appointments all fit in a table. The useful pauses, refusals and transfers of authority don't fit as neatly. [[Field methods]] should keep short accounts beside the measures. A summary can be accurate and still omit the decisions that made the year manageable.
